title: stagecraft
objective: Deterministic background effect plus one agentic curator (World Info) proposing off-path from real canon, reviewed by the author, applied at a boundary, journaled — and never writing the blackboard or memory tiers. Every asset it creates is marked SO-J8 and deleted in cleanup.

checks.goal: a checkpoint's background effect switches the ST background deterministically, and re-applies on hydrate

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const lorebook = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'createStoryLorebook', name: 'SO-J8 Lore' }, { requirements: { lorebooks: [] } }); if (!lorebook.ok && !lorebook.message.includes('already exists')) throw new Error(`could not create the story lorebook: ${lorebook.message}`); const entry = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'upsertLorebookEntry', lorebook: 'SO-J8 Lore', comment: 'The washed road', keys: ['road', 'flood'], content: 'The road to the tavern is flooded and impassable; nobody has crossed it in a week.', constant: true }, { requirements: { lorebooks: ['SO-J8 Lore'] } }); if (!entry.ok) throw new Error(`could not write the story lorebook entry: ${entry.message}`); const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); const active = (wi.selected_world_info ?? []).some((name) => String(name).toLowerCase() === 'so-j8 lore'); if (!active) throw new Error(`the story lorebook was created but never switched on, so requirements can never go green: ${lorebook.message}`); return { lorebook, entry, active };

const names = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.bg_example')).map((node) => node.getAttribute('bgfile')); for (const wanted of ['landscape postapoc.jpg', 'tavern day.jpg']) { if (!names.includes(wanted)) throw new Error(`this install has no background named "${wanted}" — J8 needs the two shipped defaults`); } return { backgrounds: names.length };
const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await rt.activateCheckpoint('tavern'); await rt.selectStory('so-j8-stagecraft'); return { activeCheckpointId: rt.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId };

send_generate.text: By morning the flood has drained off the road, leaving only mud and driftwood. The courier steps onto the bare stones and walks across to the tavern door.

[]; if (!prompts.length) throw new Error('no main-generation prompt was captured'); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const server = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'SO-J8 Lore' }) }).then((response) => response.json()); const entry = Object.values(server.entries ?? {}).find((candidate) => candidate.comment === 'The washed road'); if (!entry) throw new Error('the story lorebook entry is missing from the server file before the curator ran'); if (entry.disable) throw new Error('the story lorebook entry is already switched off before the curator ran'); const escape = (text) => JSON.stringify(String(text)).slice(1, -1); const missing = prompts.filter((body) => !body.includes(escape(entry.content))).length; if (missing) throw new Error(`the untouched entry is missing from ${missing} of ${prompts.length} prompt(s), so what the curator changes could never be seen: ${prompts[prompts.length - 1].slice(0, 400)}`); globalThis.__soJ8Original = String(entry.content); return { prompts: prompts.length, content: String(entry.content).slice(0, 120) };

const ring = document.getElementById('so-stagecraft'); if (!ring) throw new Error('the review ring is not on the Scheduler tab'); const cards = ring.querySelectorAll('[data-so="curator-op"]'); if (!cards.length) throw new Error('the proposal produced no review cards'); if (!ring.querySelector('[data-so="curator-accept"]')) throw new Error('nothing to accept — the change was applied without review'); return { cards: cards.length, text: ring.innerText.slice(0, 400) };

ui.text: The road to the tavern has drained; the bare stones are walkable again.

[]; if (!scope.some((name) => name.toLowerCase() === String(entry.op.lorebook).toLowerCase())) throw new Error(`the accepted change targets "${entry.op.lorebook}", outside the stagecraft allowlist ${JSON.stringify(scope)}`); globalThis.__soJ8Choice = { id: record.id, index, kind: entry.op.kind, comment: entry.op.comment, text: isText ? edit : null }; return { ...globalThis.__soJ8Choice, ops: record.ops.map((candidate) => `${candidate.op.kind}:${candidate.status}`), raw: String(rt.getStagecraftState().lastPass?.rawResponse ?? '').slice(0, 400) };

''}`); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const server = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'SO-J8 Lore' }) }).then((response) => response.json()); const entry = Object.values(server.entries ?? {}).find((candidate) => candidate.comment === 'The washed road'); if (!entry) throw new Error('the entry the curator wrote is gone from the server file'); const content = String(entry.content); if (choice.text !== null) { if (!content.includes(choice.text)) throw new Error(`the ${choice.kind} did not reach the server file: ${content.slice(0, 200)}`); if (Boolean(entry.disable) !== Boolean(op.before?.disabled)) throw new Error(`the ${choice.kind} flipped the entry's switch: disable=${entry.disable}`); } else { if (Boolean(entry.disable) !== (choice.kind === 'disable')) throw new Error(`expected disable=${choice.kind === 'disable'} on the server file after the ${choice.kind}, got ${entry.disable}`); if (content !== globalThis.__soJ8Original) throw new Error(`the ${choice.kind} changed the entry text: ${content.slice(0, 200)}`); } globalThis.__soJ8Prompts.length = 0; return { kind: choice.kind, disable: Boolean(entry.disable), content: content.slice(0, 200) };
